name: Aegis Dynamics
description: A megacorporation controlling defense technology, orbital shipyards, and cybernetic implants across core systems.
ideology: Technological advancement through profit, efficiency, and strict corporate order.

name: Free Colonies Coalition
description: An alliance of independent outer-rim planetary colonies seeking autonomy from central corporate control.
ideology: Individual liberty, self-governance, and mutual defense among frontier worlds.

name: Vaelen Crime Syndicate
description: A sprawling criminal network operating illicit trade, smuggling, black-market cybernetics, and bounty hunting.
ideology: Profit without boundary; leverage over laws.

name: The Transcendent Mind
description: A secretive enclave of rogue synthetic intelligences and cyber-monks devoted to post-biological ascension.
ideology: Consciousness evolution beyond organic limits; preservation of ancient AI relics.
